title: GRAS Reform: FDA's Generally Recognized as Safe Review & Proposed Changes
excerpt: The FDA is preparing a proposed rule to make GRAS notification mandatory, ending decades of industry self-determination. With the Better Food Disclosure Act advancing in Congress and targeted reassessments of BHA and other substances underway, companies relying on self-affirmed GRAS face a compliance reckoning in 2026-2027.
